command:
set -eu
echo TCON_PROVIDER_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
find /lib/modules/5.4.261 -maxdepth 8 -type f -name '*.ko' -print | (
 n=0
 m=0
 while IFS= read -r p; do
  n=$((n+1))
  if LC_ALL=C grep -a -q -w tcon_ex_proc "$p"; then
   m=$((m+1))
   test "$m" -le 20
   echo "CANDIDATE=$p"
   stat -c '%n %s' "$p"
   sha256sum "$p"
  else
   rc=$?
   test "$rc" = 1
  fi
 done
 echo "MODULES_SCANNED=$n"
 echo "CANDIDATES=$m"
)
echo TCON_PROVIDER_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: ordinary installed module-file literal scan, no load/symbol invocation
